hook.name: OrketHook
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook for prediction market pools that implements a VALS (Variable Automated Liquidity Sensitivity) fee formula. Each swap requires a signed off-chain sigma (toxic-velocity) parameter; fees are computed as e^[λ·(Δx/L)·σ]−1, captured via BeforeSwapDelta, and forwarded to a YieldDistributor rather than to LPs. Also gates swaps and liquidity on market resolution/dispute state.
